prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the best one for you depends on your business size, industry, goals, channels (SEO, PPC, social, content, analytics), and budget. I can help you find the right match. A quick guide and next step options:

Questions for me so I can recommend specific agencies
- What’s your business type (startup, SMB, enterprise) and industry (SaaS, e‑commerce, B2B, DTC, healthcare, etc.)?
- What are your primary goals (lead gen, revenue, brand awareness, app installs, retention)?
- Which channels matter most (search/SEO, paid search/PPC, paid social, CRO, content, email, analytics)?
- Rough monthly budget or annual marketing budget?
- Do you prefer a local SF boutique or a larger national/global agency?

How to pick the “best” agency for you (short checklist)
- Relevant experience: case studies and clients in your industry and channel.
- Measurable results: clear KPIs, before/after metrics, ability to show ROI.
- Transparency & reporting: sample reports, cadence, access to data.
- Team & culture: who will work on your account, senior involvement.
- Process & tools: methodologies, proprietary tech, or partnerships (Google/Facebook partners).
- Pricing & contract flexibility: month‑to‑month vs retainer, performance fees, trial projects.
- References: speak to past/current clients about results and communication.

If you want, I can:
- Create a shortlist of 4–6 SF agencies tailored to your answers above (with strengths, likely pricing range, and questions to ask each), or
- Give a list of reputable places to find vetted agency reviews (Clutch, G2, Google Partners, LinkedIn recommendations) and a templated RFP / interview checklist.

Which would you prefer? If you share the industry, goals and budget, I’ll shortlist agencies that fit.
